name: Find Pages or Data Sources
description: Searches for a page or data source. [See the documentation](https://developers.notion.com/reference/post-search)

configurable_props.name: title
configurable_props.label: Query (Title)
configurable_props.description: The object title to search for

configurable_props.name: pageSize
configurable_props.label: Page Size
configurable_props.description: The number of items from the full list desired in the response (max 100)

configurable_props.name: startCursor
configurable_props.label: Start Cursor (page_id)
configurable_props.description: Leave blank to retrieve the first page of results. Otherwise, the response will be the page of results starting after the provided cursor

configurable_props.name: filter
configurable_props.label: Page or Data Source
configurable_props.description: Whether to search for pages or data sources.
